fixes_applied_during_live_testing: mod.go: Resolve authenticated channel ID via channels.list?mine=true before commentThreads.list call (API requires one of allThreadsRelatedToChannelId/channelId/videoId/postId/id)

auth.go: Added yt-analytics.readonly and yt-analytics-monetary.readonly OAuth2 scopes (the Data API spec doesn't include them; Analytics + Reporting APIs require them)
